meta.title: Portfolio Quality Monitoring

definitions.active_loans: Jumlah loan_id unik dengan loan_state bukan CLOSED.
definitions.paid_noa: Jumlah loan_id unik dengan payment_min_1x = Yes.
definitions.rr_min1x: Paid NOA / Active NOA; indikator berdasarkan flag pembayaran di file, bukan otomatis RR resmi.
definitions.disbursement: Status dan plafond berdasarkan file daily KP; total plafond pipeline bukan seluruhnya realisasi pencairan.
definitions.noa_per_bp: Sementara dihitung sebagai Active Loan dibagi jumlah BP unik pada branch; perlu validasi jika definisi resmi berbeda.
definitions.branch_status: PQI cutoff 91.5%; NOA/BP high cutoff >40; low cutoff >=15. Classification follows user-provided rule.

target_logic.target_mitra: ceil(total unique mitra in bucket × target percentage)
target_logic.gap_mitra: max(target mitra payment - paid unique mitra, 0)
target_logic.paid_mitra: Unique customer_number with payment_min_1x = Yes in each DPD bucket
target_logic.DPD 61–90 and DPD 90+: No target/gap; paid mitra is reported as positive contribution

meta.pqi_definition: PQI = 50% × RR DPD 0 + 50% × RR DPD 0–60; RR DPD 0 = paid NOA DPD 0 / total NOA DPD 0; RR DPD 0–60 = (paid NOA DPD 0 + DPD 1–30 + DPD 31–60) / (total NOA DPD 0 + DPD 1–30 + DPD 31–60).

logic: PQI > 91.5% and NOA/BP < 15: Under Perform Sale
PQI <= 91.5% and NOA/BP >= 15: Under Perform Collection
